However, recent studies have consistently shown that these high-performance models still exhibit significant security vulnerabilities. Among these, the adversarial example problem is considered one of the most critical security challenges facing deep learning systems. excerpt_i18n.zh: AI科技评论获悉，前鉴智科技CTO 都大龙创立的公司章鱼动力已完成数亿元人民币种子轮融资。据接近交易的人士透露，本轮投资方包括地平线以及多家知名美元基金。截至目前，公司尚未正式披露融资信息。 据了解，章鱼动力的注册公司为北京章鱼灵动科技有限公司。企查查信息显示，章鱼灵动科技成立于2025年12月2日。从已公开信息来看，公司聚焦于物理AI方向。尽管外界对其业务细节了解仍有限，但从目前释放出的团队与融资信息看，这家公司起点不低。 不久前，章鱼动力首次对外披露核心联创团队。按照公司公开表述，这支团队要构建的是一支“以 Physical AGI 为使命，致力于解决物理AI图灵测试这一终局问题的队伍。” 从已公开的联创背景来看，章鱼动力的班底颇具分量。创始人兼CEO都大龙，为地平线第6号员工、鉴智机器人联合创始人，也是鉴智的灵魂人物。早在百度时期，他就是 AI 体系内颇具代表性的天才型选手，并曾获得两次百度百万美金最高奖。鉴智虽是较晚进入自动驾驶赛道的玩家，但都大龙作为公司的灵魂人物和核心推动者，长期主导技术、产品研发与交付，推动公司实现快速发展，并最终完成并购退出。 其余几位已亮相联创同样背景鲜明：梁柱锦出身地平线体系，后任鉴智机器人技术副总裁；潘杨家一曾任地平线 CFO，长期负责资本运作与战略事务；樊庆元曾任地平线业务VP，在业务拓展、商业化推进与产业协同方面经验丰富。 这样的联创组合，也让章鱼动力从一开始就展现出少见的复合能力：既有AI原生团队底色，也具备资本组织能力与业务开拓能力。 据接近公司人士透露，都大龙与余凯长期共事多年。从百度、地平线到鉴智，余凯一直对其颇为认可。此次章鱼动力获得地平线入局，在不少业内人士看来，也延续了这份长期信任。 另据接近公司人士透露，除目前已亮相的核心联创外，章鱼动力后续还将有更多重量级联创与核心成员陆续加盟。 若这一消息落地，公司团队完整度与市
excerpt_i18n.en:
AI Tech Review has learned that Octopus Power, a company founded by former CTO of Jianzhi Robotics Du Dalong, has completed a seed funding round of several hundred million yuan. Sources close to the transaction reveal that investors in this round include Horizon Robotics and several well-known U.S. dollar funds. As of now, the company has not officially disclosed the financing details.

It is understood that Octopus Power’s registered entity is Beijing Octopus Lingdong Technology Co., Ltd. Qichacha information shows that Octopus Lingdong Technology was established on December 2, 2025. Based on publicly available information, the company focuses on the direction of physical AI. Although external understanding of its business details remains limited, the team and financing information released so far indicate a high starting point for the company.

Not long ago, Octopus Power publicly disclosed its core founding team for the first time. According to the company’s statement, the team aims to build a group "with the mission of Physical AGI, dedicated to solving the ultimate challenge of the physical AI Turing test." Judging from the backgrounds of the disclosed co-founders, Octopus Power’s team carries significant weight.

Founder and CEO Du Dalong was the sixth employee at Horizon Robotics and a co-founder of Jianzhi Robotics, serving as its key driving force. As early as his tenure at Baidu, he was recognized as a representative genius within the AI division and twice received Baidu’s highest award of one million U.S. dollars. Although Jianzhi Robotics entered the autonomous driving field relatively late, Du Dalong, as the company’s core figure and main promoter, long led technology, product development, and delivery, driving rapid growth and ultimately achieving a merger and exit.

The other co-founders who have been introduced also boast impressive backgrounds.
